title: PFRDA Launches 'StAR NPS' Digital Onboarding Framework Developed by BSE Technologies
summary: Streamlines digital account opening with ₹200 registration fee for individuals aged 18 to 85.

blocks.content: Streamlines digital account opening with ₹200 registration fee for individuals aged 18 to 85.

items: Digital Platform: StAR NPS operationalised for Points of Presence (PoPs) to digitise NPS enrolment.
Fee & Eligibility: Registration fee fixed at ₹200 + tax for resident Indians aged 18 to 85 years.
Sandbox Net Worth: Non-registered sandbox applicants require ₹10 lakh minimum net worth.
